name: q-harness
description: A collection of Claude Code Harness by phuquocchamp

plugins.name: q-bash
plugins.description: Draws each Bash call as a clear bordered panel (status, time, error tail, test and git badges) and asks before destructive commands.

plugins.name: q-git
plugins.description: Shows the repository status (branch, ahead/behind, changes) above the prompt and keeps a timeline of the session's commits, pushes and PRs.

plugins.name: q-files
plugins.description: Shows what each turn read and changed in one line above the prompt, and lists the session's files with +/- lines and how much of each was read.
